text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - realtime p99 latency exceeded SLO for /v1/generate in us-east-1. p95=1.85s, p99=3.6s (SLO p99 <= 2s). Streaming stalls observed on ~10% of sessions. Paging oncall.
jamie: oncall here, seeing the alert. grabbing dashboards and traces. tagging @nora @raj. first checks: any deploys in last 30m?
nora: no deploys from product cluster in last hour. I see a sharp increase in seq len distribution — median prompt tokens up ~2.5x for the burst window. Adding grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/d/latency/instant
raj: logs show an uptick of backpressure on inference-runtime-3 pods. Some streams report repeated `write ECONNRESET` from the websocket proxy. Also a few pods show increased GC/CPU on the CPU-side preprocessors.
jamie: running quick health checks. commands:
```
# check pod restarts and resource usage
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime-3 -o wide
kubectl -n inference top pod | grep runtime-3
```
jamie: initial mitigation plan: 1) disable large-request batching for us-east-1 route, 2) enable fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for streaming clients, 3) scale replicas + increase concurrency cap temporarily.
alex: I'm on scaling. bumping replica count from 6 -> 12 on inference-runtime-3 and increasing autoscaler target. Doing a controlled traffic shift to dedicated-pool-b for 15% of requests.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: scale inference-runtime-3 replicas 6->12 by alex at 1769991298.
nora: I pushed routing override to send 15% of traffic to `dedicated-pool-b-small-model`. also toggled batching=false for the /v1/generate route in us-east-1.
jamie: quick check after mitigations: p95 back to 700ms, p99 down to 1.9s for the sample window. streaming stalls reduced but not eliminated. still seeing intermittent ECONNRESET from a small subset of clients.
raj: digging into proxy logs. a single nginx ingress instance shows high connection queue length ~1200 -> hitting accept queue. Possible SYN backlog or kernel limits. I'm increasing `net.core.somaxconn` on the node pool and restarting the nginx pods one at a time.
alex: nginx restart in progress. monitor for connection drop impact.
jamie: customer-impact note: we saw elevated error rates and latency for ~12% of sessions in us-east-1 during spike window. no data loss, but streaming stalls and a handful of 500s. CS alerted: ticket INC-2281 created.
nora: taking over on-call for remediation and follow-up. jamie handoff: actions taken = scaled runtime, disabled batching, routed 15% to fallback, increased nginx somaxconn and rotated pods. next: postmortem + recommend autoscaler config change and circuit-breaker for ingress.
jamie: thanks — I'm available for writeup. pls capture timelines and metrics. recommended follow-ups: add an alert for connection queue length at ingress, add streaming-specific p99 SLOs, and run chaos test for sudden prompt-length spikes.
raj: note for postmortem: correlate event with client-side pattern of longer prompts from partner X; we should throttle huge prefixes or route them to dedicated capacity.
ops-bot: incident severity auto-classified as Sev2 at 1769991410.
nora: closing mobile paging, will keep thread updated. creating post-incident taskboard. cc: @alex @jamie @raj. final note: latencies returned to baseline after routing + scale at ~1769991508. follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-04-01 14:00 UTC.
jamie: ack. filing postmortem and action items now. :white_check_mark:
